 AIBE 2026 Admit Card: Important Exam Day Instructions 
 The Bar Council of India (BCI) is scheduled to release the AIBE Admit Card 2026 for XXII (22) on 14 November 2026 . Candidates who have successfully registered for the All India Bar Examination can download their hall tickets from the official website, allindiabarexamination.com.
 The AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 will be available online through the candidate login portal. Candidates will need their login credentials to access and download the hall ticket. The AIBE XXII examination is scheduled to be conducted on 29 November 2026. Candidates must download their admit cards and check all the details mentioned on them before the examination.

 AIBE Admit Card 2026 Release Date and Time
 The Bar Council of India has scheduled the release of the AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 for 14 November 2026 . Registered candidates will be able to access their hall tickets through the official candidate login portal.
 The exact release time has not been officially confirmed. Candidates should regularly check the official website for updates and download their admit cards as soon as the link becomes active.
 AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 Download Link
 The AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 download link will be activated on the official website on 14 November 2026. Candidates will be required to log in using their registered credentials to download the hall ticket.
 AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 Download Link (Active on 14 Nov) 
 AIBE Admit Card Download: How to Download AIBE 22 Hall Ticket 2026
 Candidates can follow the step-by-step instructions to download your AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 once the link is activated:
 Visit the official website of the All India Bar Examination at allindiabarexamination.com.
 Find and click on the AIBE XXII Admit Card 2026 link on the homepage.
 Open the candidate login page.
 Enter the required login details, including your User ID/Application ID and Password.
 Submit the login information.
 The AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Check all the details mentioned on the hall ticket carefully.
 Download the admit card PDF and take a clear printout for examination purposes.
 Candidates should also know whether AIBE is an open-book exam to understand the permitted study materials and rules applicable during the examination.
 Login Details Required to Download the AIBE XXII Hall Ticket 2026
 Candidates must keep their login credentials ready before accessing the AIBE candidate login portal. The following details are required to download the admit card:
 Application ID/User ID: The registered identification number provided during the application process.
 Password: The password created or used during AIBE XXII registration.
 Candidates should enter their credentials carefully. If they forget their password, they can use the password recovery option available on the official website.
 Details Mentioned on the AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026
 The AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 contains important information related to the candidate and examination. After downloading the admit card, candidates should verify the following details:
 Candidate's name
 Roll number
 Application or registration details
 Examination name
 Candidate's photograph
 Candidate's signature
 Examination date
 Examination timing
 Reporting time
 Examination centre name and address
 Important examination-day instructions
 Candidates can also check the AIBE Syllabus to understand the subjects and important topics covered in the examination and plan their preparation effectively.
 How to Correct Errors on the AIBE Admit Card 2026?
 After downloading the AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026, candidates should carefully verify all the information printed on it. If they find any incorrect details, such as a spelling mistake in their name, incorrect photograph, signature, or other personal information, they should contact the Bar Council of India helpdesk immediately.
 Candidates can follow these steps:
 Identify the incorrect information mentioned on the admit card.
 Keep the application form and relevant supporting documents ready.
 Contact the AIBE helpdesk through the available official contact details.
 Explain the discrepancy and provide the required information.
 Follow the instructions given by the examination authority for correction.
 AIBE Helpdesk Contact Details: 
 Helpdesk Number: +91 8655701484
 Additional Contact Numbers: 07553128691, 011-49225023, 011-49225022
 Candidates should report errors as soon as possible to avoid difficulties on the examination day.
 AIBE 2026 Admit Card: Important Exam Day Instructions
 Candidates appearing for the AIBE XXII examination should follow the instructions mentioned on their admit cards. Some important points to remember are:
 Carry a printed copy of the AIBE 22 admit card to the examination centre.
 Bring a valid government-issued photo identity proof.
 Reach the examination centre according to the reporting time mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Check the examination centre address in advance to avoid last-minute confusion.
 Do not carry prohibited electronic devices, such as mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, or headphones.
 Follow all instructions issued by the examination authority.
 Keep the admit card safe until the examination process is completed.
